title: Reputation catalog
description: The faction reputation meters shown on the map and in the HUD: which value they track and where each tier starts.
x-help:
A reputation faction is a meter tied to an actor value. When the actor value changes the HUD shows the faction's meter, and the map's reputation panel lists the tier the player has reached.

Each faction has exactly seven tiers. A tier's threshold is the actor value at which that tier begins, and the seven thresholds must rise from the first to the last. The label is the tier's name.

Only the Crater and Foundation factions have HUD artwork; a faction with another code is skipped. A faction without a name or an actor value is skipped too.
